card.fact_statement: The James Webb Space Telescope measured the mid-infrared thermal emission of 2024 YR4.
card.source_span: Measurements of 2024 YR4's mid-infrared thermal emission by the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) on 26 March 2025 indicate that it has a diameter of 60 m (200 ft)

card.fact_statement: 2025 GN1 was discovered using the Víctor M. Blanco Telescope.
card.source_span: 2025 GN1 was discovered on 4 April 2025, by the 4.0-meter (13.1 ft) Víctor M. Blanco Telescope's Dark Energy Camera (DECam)
